answer.reason: Both provide business software and serve small businesses. Paylocity centers on employer HR, payroll, benefits, and spend management; Intuit emphasizes accounting, invoicing, tax, and marketing, while also serving consumers and accounting firms. The passages support adjacency, but do not establish direct competition in core HR and payroll products.
answer.missing_evidence: No supplied Intuit passage establishes employer payroll, benefits administration, or broader HCM capabilities comparable to Paylocity.
